title: Limited visual presentation of text (AAA)
user_impact: Users with visual impairments or dyslexia have difficulty reading.
technical_impact: Insufficient CSS styling for line spacing or justified-text formatting.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.8 Visual Presentation (Level AAA), bullets 1, 2 and 5
applicability: Every page in an AAA audit (a fixed page-wide UNTESTED note; justified text and line height are the automated text/* ids).
expectation:
Emits one page-wide UNTESTED note in every AAA audit, never a pass and never
a violation. Strictly, 1.4.8 applies only to blocks of text, so a page
without any (visual_no_text) should not get the note; the note is
unconditional today, which is why no not-applicable case exists.
manual_reason: 1.4.8 also requires that users can select foreground and background colours and that text blocks stay within 80 characters; whether a mechanism exists and how wide a block renders for the user's chosen font cannot be decided from markup or style.

failing.html:
Text alignment, reading order, and spacing

This paragraph uses justified text alignment, which creates uneven spacing between words and can make reading more difficult for some users.
